title: piper excelsum subsp. peltatum
intro: Piper excelsum subsp. peltatum, commonly known as Peltatum Pepper, is a subspecies of the Piper excelsum plant, a type of flowering plant in the pepper family (Piperaceae). It is native to the tropical regions of Central and South America and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Peltatum Pepper include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating pain, wounds, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include various alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
